insights.title: Checkout and payment: Families, Group platters drop off far more often than everyone else
insights.summary: Users in the 'Families, Group platters' segment are experiencing a technical bug at the 'Checkout and payment' screen. This is evidenced by a high exit rate, frequent rage taps on the 'pay' button, and a significant number of errors, particularly 'gateway_timeout'.
insights.hypothesis: Users in the 'Families, Group platters' segment are experiencing a technical bug at the 'Checkout and payment' screen. This is evidenced by a high exit rate, frequent rage taps on the 'pay' button, and a significant number of errors, particularly 'gateway_timeout'.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the 'gateway_timeout' error code to understand its root cause and frequency for the 'Families, Group platters' segment. Address the underlying technical issue causing the 'gateway_timeout' errors and rage taps on the 'pay' button.
